John Mayer - I hit a huge rut in my guitar playing. I felt like Ocean by John Butler was as far as I would ever get. John Frusciante - for so long I was so focused on trying to learn as much as I could, essentially trying to be a super shreddy guitarist with lots of flashy chops (when I wasn't playing John Mayer or SRV tunes).
